groups.summary: Non-admin delete filter matches system-owned repos, letting any user delete them
groups.reason: In src/store.ts:29, Store.deleteRepo builds the non-admin delete query as `DELETE FROM repos WHERE id = ? AND (owner = ? OR owner = 'system')`, so it also deletes rows owned by `system`. The route deleteRepo in src/routes.ts:28 does no ownership check of its own. It just passes req.params.id and req.user to this method. Removing `OR owner = 'system'` from the store query fixes the store method, and the route inherits that fix, so one change resolves both tickets.
